topic: Database space and job status check
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on managing database resources, specifically addressing potential storage issues. [p1] reported clearing logs and restarting the server to free up disk space. [me] confirmed freeing significant log space across different servers (e.g., 13GB on one, 300MB on another) and noted that memory might be a factor rather than just disk space.

Regarding job status, [p1] requested assistance with running jobs. [me] confirmed ability to run the jobs but noted that one specific job appeared to have already failed. [me] committed to investigating the issue within the day.
decisions: Log files were cleared and servers were restarted to free up disk space.
action_items: [me] will investigate the status of a specific job failure during the day.
